# ComputeRegionInstanceTemplate

`compute.gcp.hfl.dev/v1alpha1`

**Gap it fills.** Terraform's `google_compute_region_instance_template`. A regional instance template; Config Connector's ComputeInstanceTemplate is global only.

**Source.** generated by `hack/discokind` from the compute.v1 Discovery document.

## Notes

Generated by `hack/discokind` from `hack/discokind/kinds.yaml` (`docs/design.md`
section 2.4); its test is `pkg/discokind/kindtest` with the fixtures under
`pkg/controller/direct/compute/discokindtest/testdata/discokind/ComputeRegionInstanceTemplate/`.

**Customer-supplied keys (CSEK) are left out** (2026-11-27, HFL-699).
The spec has no `rawKey` or `rsaEncryptedKey` under
`properties.disks[].diskEncryptionKey`,
`properties.disks[].initializeParams.sourceImageEncryptionKey` or
`properties.disks[].initializeParams.sourceSnapshotEncryptionKey`
(`skip` in `hack/discokind/kinds.yaml`). They were plain strings, so a
key would have sat in the manifest in plain text; `secrets` cannot
reach a field inside a list item; Terraform marks `raw_key` Sensitive;
and the Compute API marks CSEK deprecated ("CSEK is no longer
supported. Use CMEK instead."). The supported path is a Cloud KMS key
(CMEK): `kmsKeyName`, and `kmsKeyServiceAccount` when the Compute
Engine default service account is not the one to use, both still in
each of the three objects. A disk made from a CSEK-encrypted image or
snapshot cannot be described by this kind.
